headline: G7 agrees to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil
deck: The release follows Trump's threat to ban diesel exports to Europe; the G7 agree not to restrict energy exports among themselves.
standard: The G7 countries will release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil through the International Energy Agency over four months, starting immediately, with a large diesel release in the first 20 days. Emmanuel Macron, France's president, announced it on Friday after a video meeting of G7 leaders.
It follows Donald Trump raising the possibility on Wednesday of banning diesel exports to Europe. The G7 countries have agreed not to restrict energy exports among themselves.
Jens Nærvig Pedersen, commodity analyst at Danske Bank, tells Ritzau the release may take the top off diesel prices in Denmark but does not solve the supply crisis.
short: The G7 countries will release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil over four months, Emmanuel Macron, France's president, announced on Friday. It follows Donald Trump raising the possibility on Wednesday of banning diesel exports to Europe.
